primitives.name: QuantizedAxis
primitives.summary: Float values move onto a quantization lattice; mix moves actual locations and saturation changes clipped integer values.
primitives.signature: ({s, values, scale, zeroPoint=0, mix, min=-128, max=127, y=0, progress=1})

primitives.name: TensorBars
primitives.summary: Numerical tensor/channel values set signed bar lengths; active mask removes whole channels and names preserve correspondence.
primitives.signature: ({s, values, names?, active?, x=0, y=0, step=1, gain=1, color?, progress=1})

primitives.name: SignalWindow
primitives.summary: Signal amplitudes determine stems; start/size move a highlighted receptive window over persistent samples; cursor follows consumed samples.

primitives.name: TensorMemory
primitives.summary: Tensor allocations use byte offset/size; advancing time releases expired lifetimes and admits newly live tensors at reusable offsets.

primitives.name: OperatorPartitions
primitives.summary: Supported operator contents and processor membership are explicit; partitioned changes device lane and handoff moves a payload between actual endpoints.

primitives.name: ScoreDistribution
primitives.summary: Numerical probability scores set bar heights; threshold line intersects scores and changes admitted outcomes.

primitives.name: EnergyTimeline
primitives.summary: Power samples form true rectangular area slices; count advances elapsed-time cursor and accumulated energy from power*dt.
